purpose: Document first-party local/state registry evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-service review for Wad Madanī.
assessment: The official Al Jazirah state ministry documents a Land Authority plus Planning and Survey directorates, including land allocation, lease contracts, detailed plans, and survey-approved sketches. The National Information Centre documents a Sudan Spatial Portal with WMS/WFS capabilities, but the portal root timed out during anonymous inspection. No parcel geometry or safe parcel identity was verified, and no sample was retained.
registryAssessment: Local/state land-administration custody is evidenced through the official Al Jazirah ministry. No open digital parcel registry or public cadastral geometry endpoint was verified.
